name: shipper-app-store-connect
description: Validate and upload local iOS and macOS builds to App Store Connect from ChatGPT Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Validate and deliver local .ipa and .pkg builds
interface.longDescription: Use ChatGPT Desktop on macOS to list configured Apple Developer teams, validate a local .ipa or .pkg with Apple's Transporter, and upload it to App Store Connect. Requires Xcode and a one-time local Apple Account setup. No Shipper UI app is required.
defaultPrompt: List the App Store Connect teams configured on this Mac
Validate this local IPA without uploading it
Upload this IPA to App Store Connect after validation
